justification.text: `↑(AdditiveCombinatorics.sumRep A n) / Real.log ↑n` is the problem's ratio 1_A∗1_A(n)/log n whose limit is asserted as n → ∞, and Real.log n = 0 only for n ∈ {0, 1}, which the limit along atTop never sees, so the denominator is positive wherever it matters.
